I am excited to submit my application for the Communications Officer position at the International Dairy Federation. # Baver Ok
Digital Communications · Content · SEO · Web
Zwijndrecht, Belgium | +32 470 42 48 36 | baverok@gmail.com | linkedin.com/in/baverok

## Profile

At Episto, I create keyword-targeted content and manage WordPress sites, translating client needs into clear, engaging web experiences. On my own project (mirook.com), I've applied structured data and entity optimization to improve visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines, demonstrating my ability to simplify complex information for broader audiences.
